pattern: Keyboard input markup: a kbd element for the combination with one nested kbd per key (HTML kbd semantics).

roles.role: none (aria-hidden=true; a visually hidden name follows)

aria.value: true; the key name is provided as visually hidden text

keyboard.action: Not focusable; read in document order by assistive technology.

notes: Symbols such as the Command sign are hidden from assistive technology and replaced by localized names ('Command'), so screen readers do not announce unknown glyphs.
Shortcuts supplement, never replace, a visible way to reach the command.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
